[web - flash] Monsters' Den: Book of Dread - a turn-based dungeon crawler

I've already posted one turn-based dungeon crawler, The Wizard, but these two games have almost nothing in common. Monsters' Den is a traditional type of dungeon crawler, with randomized loot and dungeon level generation, though the fact that it's turn-based gives it a little twist. The Wizard has a much more unique style.

This is the second game in what is currently a three-game series. I'm linking #2 because it's better than the first game and doesn't get bogged down with unnecessarily complicated combat like the third game. Though the third game is definitely better looking.
